update.notes:
### Features

- *(updates)* the update alert carries the release notes of the version it offers
- *(updates)* a third button skips a version and stops offering it
- *(sidebar)* keep every control in the bar, and even the margins
- *(review)* fold the files you have already read
- *(composer)* a folder dropped on the composer becomes a mention

### Bug Fixes

- *(archive)* an archive no longer reports a worktree it had already removed
- *(terminal)* a pane whose tmux server went away is reopened rather than left blank
- *(git)* a branch with a slash in its name is quoted before it reaches git
- a signing identity whose name carries an accent reaches `codesign` intact

### Performance

- the diff stat refresh reads one revision rather than the whole worktree

See the [release page](https://github.com/akira-foundation/unified-dev-swift/releases) for everything that went with it.
